name: Racial or Ethnic Origin
description: Personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin (§ 59.1-575, sensitive data (1)).

name: Religious Beliefs
description: Personal data revealing religious beliefs (§ 59.1-575, sensitive data (1)).

name: Mental or Physical Health Diagnosis
description: Personal data revealing mental or physical health diagnosis (§ 59.1-575, sensitive data (1)).

name: Sexual Orientation
description: Personal data revealing sexual orientation (§ 59.1-575, sensitive data (1)).

name: Citizenship or Immigration Status
description: Personal data revealing citizenship or immigration status (§ 59.1-575, sensitive data (1)).

name: Genetic or Biometric Data
description: The processing of genetic or biometric data for the purpose of uniquely identifying a natural person (§ 59.1-575, sensitive data (2)).

name: Personal Data Collected from a Known Child
description: The personal data collected from a known child, meaning any natural person younger than 13 years of age (§ 59.1-575, sensitive data (3)).

name: Precise Geolocation Data
description: Information that directly identifies the specific location of a natural person with precision and accuracy within a radius of 1,750 feet, excluding the content of communications and data generated by or connected to advanced utility metering infrastructure (§ 59.1-575, sensitive data (4)).
